verdicts.reason: A is the portrait poster pasted unchanged into the middle of a square canvas: it wasn't rearranged at all, and it leaves wide empty white bars on the left and right and a large dead band between the collage and the copy, so it is pillarboxed, not a resize. B breaks the design: the diamond photo collage is gone, leaving faint empty diamond outlines over a big blank area at left; the photo is now a small plain rectangle; the right edge of the date diamond is cut off; the headline rule sits alone, far from its headline; and the body copy is tiny, though the stacked SAVE YOUR CITY headline is strong.
